landing.badgeText: Built for founders in Saudi Arabia
landing.promptLabel: Start by describing your idea in a sentence
landing.heroSub: Darb is an AI platform that helps you test a business idea before you launch. See how it could perform in the Saudi market, understand the risks, and get a clear path to setting it up.
landing.hb1: What problem does your startup solve, and who is it for?
landing.hb2: A booking app for home food businesses in Riyadh.
landing.featTitle: Everything a founder needs, on one clear path.
landing.featSub: One conversation gives you a score you can understand, the startups closest to your idea, the market around it, and the steps to launch.
landing.f1b: Darb starts by asking about your idea. Its questions adapt to your answers, so it learns your sector, your customers, your business model and anything else that matters. Everything Darb shows you afterwards is built on that conversation.
landing.cv1: What problem does your startup solve, and who is it for?
landing.cv2: A booking app for home food businesses in Riyadh.
landing.cv3: Great. Will you handle deliveries yourself or work with a delivery partner?
landing.cv4: We'll work with a delivery app.
landing.f2b: Darb gives your idea a score from 0 to 100, based on the idea itself and its market. It also shows what pushed the score up and what pulled it down, so you can see your strengths, your risks and what needs more thought.
landing.gaugeNote: Based on your idea and its market potential.
landing.f3b: Darb finds the Saudi startups closest to your idea, so you can see what they offer, where they operate and how far they have come.
landing.f5b: Darb lays out what you need to set up your business in Saudi Arabia: the registrations and licenses, in the order you need them, each with the authority responsible for it.
landing.f6b: Darb puts your whole assessment into one report. Review your results, come back to earlier assessments, and keep a clear record of your analysis and roadmap.
landing.exSub: Darb is more than an assessment. Three explorers let you browse the startups, the support programs and the regulations that make up the Saudi startup scene.
landing.x1b: Browse startups across Saudi Arabia by sector, region and stage, and see who is already operating in your market.
landing.x2b: Find incubators and accelerators across Saudi Arabia, and the programs that fit your sector, your stage and what you need.
landing.x3b: Look up regulatory and licensing requirements by activity and sector, with the responsible authorities, all in one place.
landing.srcSub: Darb's market analysis and regulatory guidance are based on information published by Saudi government entities.
landing.srcDisclaimer: Darb is an independent academic project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the entities listed above.
landing.aboutTitle: Built for founders in Saudi Arabia
landing.aboutP1: Darb brings idea assessment, Saudi market data, similar startups and setup requirements together in one AI platform.
landing.aboutP2: It is designed around how business works in Saudi Arabia, so you can study an opportunity, understand its market and find your way from idea to launch in one place.
landing.ksu: Darb is a graduation project by students of the College of Computer and Information Sciences at King Saud University.
landing.ctaTitle: Find the path for your idea.
landing.ctaSub: Explore your idea, see where it stands in the Saudi market, and get a clear path to launch.
